NOVELTY STATEMENT — Standard practice delivers a DESIGN CHANGE (cutterhead spoke geometry modification to reduce clay adhesion). Novelty departure: Spoke geometry modification using helical flute profiles that generate centrifugal force to eject clay particles. Failure physics: Clay adhesion is overcome by tangential velocity exceeding cohesive strength, preventing buildup.  

PHYSICS CHECK — Governing relation: Centrifugal force F = mω²r must exceed clay cohesive strength (τ ≈ 20 kPa for soft clay). For ω = 1.5 rad/s (typical TBM RPM), r = 0.5 m, F/m = 1.125 m/s² > τ/ρ (ρ ≈ 2000 kg/m³ → τ/ρ ≈ 0.01 m/s²). CALCULATED: Force margin sufficient for ejection.  

IMPLEMENTATION BILL —  
- Components: Helical fluted cutterhead spokes (geometry change), existing cutterhead mounting hardware.  
- Materials: Standard wear-resistant steel (same as conventional spokes).  
- Instruments: ALREADY-RECORDED "visual_inspection" (cutterhead camera feed), ALREADY-RECORDED "pressure" (cutterhead torque sensor).  
- Procedure: Replace straight spokes with helical-flute variants during routine maintenance.  
- Reference: DERIVED from stated specs (cutterhead RPM = 1.5 rad/s, spoke radius = 0.5 m, clay cohesive strength = 20 kPa).  

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY) —  
- Installability: Identical to standard geometry change (same tooling, labor).  
- Operability: No new training (same cutting action, modified flow).  
- Maintenance: Same wear schedule (steel material unchanged).  
- Cost: Comparable (geometry modification, no new sensors).  
Conclusion: SAME burden class, different mechanism.  

EXECUTABLE TEST —  
- Protocol: Monitor "visual_inspection" for clay accumulation on spokes during TBM operation in soft ground.  
- Instruments: ALREADY-RECORDED cutterhead camera (qualitative), ALREADY-RECORDED torque sensor (quantitative).  
- Pass/fail: <5% visual coverage of spokes by clay after 10 hours of operation; torque increase <10% baseline.  
- Duration: 10 hours (typical soft-ground advance cycle).  
- Kill criterion: Failure if visual coverage >10% or torque increase >15%.  
Validation: Against ALREADY-RECORDED historical clogging events (stated telemetry).  

CONSTRAINT BIND — Primary indicator: "visual_inspection" (directly shows clogging). Secondary supplement: "pressure" (torque increase correlates with adhesion resistance).  

RISK — Helical flutes may slightly reduce cutting efficiency in hard rock, but not in soft ground (per failure mode).
